title: M3 first-slice state diagnosis and assessment packets
description: YWE-owned first-slice transport for complete canonical semantic diagnostic and envelope records, explicit source/profile evidence, bounded input observations and retained failures. Structural conformance is not proof of source verification, dynamic binding equality, orbit computation, capture truth or executed recovery.

BoundedExplanation.description: Explicit YWE first-slice producer bound: at most 512 characters for notes and declared unavailable-evidence reasons. This is not an upstream ASH-wide limit.

RuleIDs.description: Only reviewed first-slice evaluated/catch-all rule identities; runtime establishes evaluation and order.

CanonicalAshBinding.description: Fixed declared identity pins. Matching these values does not prove that source verification occurred.

DiagnosticContext.description: Runtime additionally requires the detection and classification references to differ.

RejectedCandidateEvidence.description: Local rejected-observation branch; it is not an AshState or a captured full raw object.

CaptureReceipt.description: Structural receipt vocabulary; actual acknowledgment/no-append truth is the collaborator and StateModel obligation.
